title: daveio chart values
description: Enough schema to catch the mistakes that would deploy successfully and be wrong: a missing public URL, a self-hosted deployment mode, an empty image repository.

deploymentMode.description: This chart only deploys the multi-tenant service. A self-hosted deployment is docker compose on one machine.

publicBaseUrl.description: Must be https and must not end in a slash: it is concatenated with /auth/google/callback and matched by Google character for character.
